fnol_text: My name is Dana Al-Sayed and I live at 929 Kestrel Court, Greenville, SC 29637. You can reach me on (555) 711-1779 or dana.alsayed@example.com. On 9 July 2025 flash flooding came down the street while my car was parked at home. Water got into the cabin and the engine won't start. Policy MT-2025-00109. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car. I assume this is covered under my policy?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Al-Sayed on (555) 711-1779 to acknowledge the claim. Dana confirmed the loss date as 9 July 2025.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Ingrid Kaminski gave a statement by phone.
Dana sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
